easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Necroplasm. Then, the draw will be replaced by Necroplasm's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Necroplasm from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
